title: On-Call Traffic and Transportation Engineering Services
short_description: On-call traffic and transportation engineering services for Howard County on an as-needed basis.
project_scope: Establishment of one or more on-call contracts for as-needed traffic and transportation engineering services for Howard County, Maryland. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific structure, span, floor area, or defined construction project is described.
services: On-call consulting services for traffic and transportation engineering, including civil, geotechnical, structural, and traffic design engineering as needed.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a general on-call framework-style services procurement without a defined bridge or special structure project.
- No specific structural scope, span, building size, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- The notice focuses on traffic and transportation engineering services rather than a concrete structural design opportunity.
- Structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, but only as part of broad as-needed consulting services.
- Framework/on-call procurements without technical specification are generally of low interest for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice describes only an on-call professional services contract with no defined project, quantities, or construction scope, so no realistic construction cost estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is an indefinite-delivery on-call services procurement with unknown task orders, duration, and volume, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms are sought for on-call traffic and transportation engineering services. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No detailed minimum reference requirements are provided in the notice excerpt.
award_criteria: Best value to the County. The County reserves the right to make one or more awards to responsible consultants whose proposals represent the best value. No weighting is stated in the notice excerpt.
